confidence_notes: Holistic July 2026 estimate; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because summer tourist demand moves accommodation prices widely, and hostel values may run higher in peak weeks. Cocktail and wine are derived from the draught beer anchor (about 2x and 1.3x) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from web search summaries attributed to the RBA homepage (14 Oct 2026, 4pm) and was not verified against the RBA's own table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Scaled from the supplied London, Amsterdam and Lisbon observations: restaurant and drink anchors sit about 15-20% below London and close to Amsterdam, while hostel and hotel anchors are near London levels, with Lisbon as a lower reference point.
